description: Angular NgRx Effects class for handling asynchronous operations related to 'todos'. It listens to dispatched actions and interacts with TodosService to perform CRUD operations, then dispatches success or failure actions accordingly.

classes.name: TodosEffects
classes.description: Effect class managing side-effects for todo actions, including load, add, toggle, and remove operations.

methods.name: load$
methods.description: Effect that loads all todos when load action is dispatched.

methods.name: add$
methods.description: Effect that adds a new todo when add action is dispatched.

methods.name: toggle$
methods.description: Effect that toggles a todo's completion status.

methods.name: remove$
methods.description: Effect that removes a todo by id.
